# 00000003897

**English.** Definition: The V-topology of almost mathematics is the uniform structure generated by annihilators of the square of the maximal ideal. Conjecture: The almost-uniform structure of an almost ring is generated by the minimal almost submodule of the integral closure, the generator being unique up to a unit. (almost basis unique generation)

**中文。** 定义：almost 数学的 V-拓扑指由极大理想的平方零化生成的一致结构。猜想：almost 环的几乎一致结构由整数闭包的极小几乎子模生成,该生成子模在同构差一个单位的意义下唯一。（almost 基唯一生成）
